Korean Classroom — SCROLL STUDIO adaptation (2026-10-20)

Based on “Classroom” by Pino_156 (Sketchfab username: titi_156)
Original: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/classroom-d4553cc2008242849214e4cbf8ad8551
Author: https://sketchfab.com/titi_156

Changes: Rebuilt the room and desks in a Korean classroom style. Simplified and
re-materialed the source chair. Replaced textures with flat materials. Added
wood-framed windows, green chalkboard, lower mint walls, ceiling lights/AC,
lockers, two separate sliding doors, seat anchors and SCROLL interaction metadata.
